items.prompt: Two Random instances use the same seed and the same sequence of method calls. What do matching draws establish?

options.why: They are replaying the same deterministic sequence.

options.text: That the simulated market model is empirically correct
options.why: Generator reproduction does not validate a real model.

options.text: Reproduction under that recorded setup, not independence
options.why: Equal-seeded replay is useful for debugging, not extra independent evidence.

options.text: That no version or call-order record is useful
options.why: Those details still matter to derived algorithms and reproducibility.

items.explanation: Replay is a software property. Independent sampling is a probability/model requirement that equal-seeded copies do not provide.
